caption: The drawing features a single object, a pair of eyeglasses, positioned horizontally in the center of the image against a plain, light beige background. The glasses have thin wire frames and distinctive octagonal-shaped lenses. The temples of the glasses are straight and extend outward to either side, each ending in a small loop. The bridge connecting the two lenses is slightly arched. The color of the frames is rendered in a subtle grayish tone, and the transparent lenses reveal fine, faint lines, suggesting glass. In the bottom right corner, the name "D. Kirkpatrick" is inscribed in small handwriting.
title: Spectacles
